svg.title: An active left column and a waiting right column
svg.desc: Contrast dense left-column activity with the right column's sparse request and waiting clock. Preserve the divider so temporal overlap cannot be mistaken for a causal dependency.

Preserve the divider so temporal overlap cannot be mistaken for a causal dependency.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "scatter", "box": [ 0.06775, 0.2012, 0.3913, 0.276474 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "ACTIVITY", "label_box": [ 0.06775, 0.49443, 0.3913, 0.121481 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "clock", "box": [ 0.626242, 0.2012, 0.184316, 0.276474 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "WAIT", "label_box": [ 0.52275, 0.49443, 0.3913, 0.121481 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "boundary", "box": [ 0.49363, 0.0734, 0.01274, 0.6248 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "split", "source": "
**Frame:** The two columns at full height, side by side, with the hard rule still between them. Left is dense and moving. Right is one request and a long wait. No arrow crosses.

**Action:** Both threads belong to the same population; the chronology does not establish a causal link between them.

**Caption:**
> THE BOARD IS NOT A PLAN.
>
> IT IS A PLACE WHERE UNRELATED WORK BECOMES VISIBLE TO STRANGERS.

**Provenance:** `inferred` — project analysis of the documented parallel chronology.
